variables.WORKSPACE_ID: Workspace ID (defaults to the current CLI workspace; set via cloudrobo workspace use --workspace-id <id>)
variables.CATALOG_ID: Workspace asset_catalog_id from cloudrobo workspace current
variables.SOURCE_TYPE: Input source type: local | asset | obs
variables.OBS_PATH: Raw data OBS path when SOURCE_TYPE=obs (obs://...)
variables.LOCAL_PATH: Raw data local directory when SOURCE_TYPE=local
variables.DATASET_NAME: Name for the registered input dataset asset
variables.DATASET_ASSET_ID: Input dataset asset_id (SOURCE_TYPE=asset, or returned by create-asset)
variables.DATA_SOURCE_TYPE: Input format label: h5 | ros2 | umi (does not select the operator)
variables.ROBOT_TYPE: Robot type; map to the operator's robot env enum or ask the user
variables.NEW_TIMESTAMP: Fresh MMDDHHmmss for a retry task name
variables.STAGE_ID: Stage id: convert-lerobotv3 | cleaning | quality-eval | diversity-eval
variables.TASK_ID: Existing proc task ID (conversion or cleaning)
variables.EVAL_TASK_ID: Existing eval task ID (quality-eval or diversity-eval)
variables.TARGET_ASSET_ID: target_asset_id from proc show-task of a SUCCEEDED stage
variables.REPORT_FILE_NAME: target_report_path from eval show-task without the obs://<bucket>/ prefix
variables.QUALITY_EVAL_TASK_CONFIG: Quality eval task_config JSON (no robot_config; optional config mounts via inputs, e.g. ROBOT_CONFIG_PATH)
variables.DIVERSITY_EVAL_TASK_CONFIG: Diversity eval task_config JSON (no robot_config; optional config mounts via inputs, e.g. ROBOT_CONFIG_PATH)
variables.ALGO_TYPE: PRESET_ASSETS | WORKSPACE_ASSETS | OBS_ASSETS from the stage operator_source (preset | workspace | obs); proc tasks only
variables.RETRY_TASK_CONFIG: Rebuilt task_config for a retry (fresh operator discovery)

required: HUAWEI_CLOUD_AK/HUAWEI_CLOUD_SK or cloudrobo config set ak <ak> sk <sk>

notes: Read-only tests TC-01 to TC-21 are run by scripts/test-cli-commands.sh; TC-22 and TC-23 are read-only and run manually with their variables.

Mutation tests TC-24 to TC-32 are never run automatically. Each requires the execution plan (operators name/id/image, envs, inputs, specs, pool, output names and paths) to be shown and explicitly confirmed by the user.
Set TASK_ID for TC-13 to TC-16 (and TC-23), EVAL_TASK_ID for TC-17 to TC-20, TARGET_ASSET_ID for TC-21 (and VERSION_ID for TC-22).
TC-05 to TC-10: if a required operator is not published in the current region, stop and tell the user; never substitute another operator.

Proc stages: create-task without --wait, then dataset proc wait-task --task-id <id> --timeout 3600, then show-task. Evaluation: create both eval tasks without --wait, then dataset eval wait-task for each task_id.

There is no in-place retry: a failed stage is retried with a NEW create-task (TC-32) after diagnosis with get-log and user confirmation. A failed evaluation member is retried by re-running TC-30 or TC-31 with a new timestamp.
